one_liner.zh: 本周加密独自下台阶：BTC -12.7%、ETH 更弱，强趋势下跌对上美股 ES/NQ 收红与 VIX 大降，标签直接写成「脱钩：股强币弱」；杠杆侧价格剧烈而 OI 仅小幅收缩、偏换手/挤压，实现波动抬高但 IV 相对 RV 仍折价，现货 ETF 通道继续强流出。
one_liner.en: Crypto stepped down alone: BTC -12.7%, ETH weaker, strong downtrend versus ES/NQ greener and VIX collapsing—labeled decoupled equities-up/crypto-down; leverage saw big price moves with only modest OI shrink (churn/squeeze tone), realized vol elevated while IV still cheap vs RV, and spot ETF channel stayed in strong outflow.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -10.65 亿美金

risk.zh: 高实现波动叠加持续强流出与负资金费率环境，若脱钩延续，下行拥挤与流动性摩擦仍可能被放大；期权偏便宜并不自动等于安全垫；杠杆读法：盯拥挤线（费率路径+OI）与出清线（2026-11-14 峰是否双高、次日是否退烧）。
risk.en: High realized vol plus ongoing strong outflows and soft negative funding can still amplify downside crowding and liquidity friction if the decouple holds; cheap IV is not an automatic cushion; Leverage read: crowding (funding path+OI) and flush (2026-11-14 peak dual-high? next-day cool-down?).

watch.zh: 盯脱钩是否收束、ETF 流出是否减速、以及 IV-RV 折价在高 RV 下会否收敛。
watch.en: Watch whether the decouple closes, ETF outflows slow, and the IV-RV discount narrows under still-high RV.

leverage.zh: 价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏便宜（IV 相对 RV 折价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口收益 -12.7%，ETH -13.7%，节奏同向偏弱；对照传统括号内 ES +2.4%、NQ +3.5%，VIX 大跌约四分之一，黄金亦录得回撤，美元与美债收益率偏强——同一周里风险资产内部出现清晰的「股强币弱」分层，而不是全球风险偏好的统一叙事。
compare.en: BTC window return -12.7%, ETH -13.7%, both soft in tandem; against the TradFi bracket ES +2.4%, NQ +3.5%, VIX down roughly a quarter, gold also weaker, dollar and yields firmer—a clean equities-up/crypto-down split inside the same week rather than one global risk-on story.

path.zh: 路径标签为强趋势下跌：从 baseline 到周末，跌幅加深且未出现有说服力的反转结构；与上周已偏弱的收益相比，本周斜率更陡，注意力标签由 S1 抬到 S2，市场更需要抬头确认是否只是惯性下杀还是结构切换。
path.en: Path labeled strong downtrend: from baseline through week-end the drawdown deepened without a convincing reversal structure; steeper than the already-soft prior week, attention lifted S1→S2 so the tape needs a clearer read on inertia versus regime shift.

leverage.zh:
标签：价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +6.27%/yr → 期末约 -1.39%/yr，租金全周降温；OI 周变约 -2.17%（95595 → 93519），库存周内回落，偏去杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 11-14（2026-11-14）；峰值约 3.08× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 -6.1%；当日 OI 约 97946；但 OI 周高在 2026-11-12（约 101147），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-11-15：OI 自峰值日回落至约 93519、funding 年化约 -1.39%/yr、价格约 +1.9%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 996.44 亿美金，环比约 +26.4%，活跃度偏热；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：①②③ 共同核对「价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）」标签是否站得住；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: two_sided_churn.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+6.27%/yr → ~-1.39%/yr — rent cooled over the week; OI week change ~-2.17% (95595 → 93519), inventory down on the week — lean deleveraging.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-11-14; peak ~3.08× median liq qty; price that day ~-6.1%; OI that day ~97946; OI week-high was 2026-11-12 (~101147), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-11-15: OI eased to ~93519; funding ~-1.39%/yr; price ~+1.9%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~99.64B, WoW ~+26.4%, activity hot; activity only, not long/short.
Close: lines ①–③ check whether label “two_sided_churn” holds; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 -10.65 亿美金，通道标签强流出（0 个净流入日 / 5 个净流出日，单日最深约 -3.0 亿量级）；ETH ETF 同期约 -3.99 亿美金。并陈 Binance 口径现货成交额周合计约 107.75 亿美金、环比约 +32%，现货通道既「流出」又「成交热闹」，只作并列观察、不焊死因果。累计仍处高位但本周斜率向下。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs summed to about -1.07B net, channel strong outflow (0 inflow / 5 outflow days, deepest day near -300M); ETH ETFs about -398.9M. Alongside, spot exchange turnover ~10.77B on the week, ~+32% WoW—outflow channel plus busy spot prints, shown in parallel without forced causality. Cumulative level still elevated but this week’s slope negative.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 107.75 亿美金，相对上完整周 +32.4%（活跃度「偏热」；上周约 81.37 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-11-14（21.54 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 996.44 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 10.77B, vs prior full week +32.4% (activity “hot”; prior ~8.14B). Peak day 2026-11-14 (2.15B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (99.64B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 高 RV + IV 折价，常见于已实现路径已经很吵、而远期报价尚未把同一噪声全额写进权利金；它描述的是相对定价位置，不是下一周方向说明书。
vol_teach.en: High RV with IV at a discount often means the realized path already made noise while forward quotes have not fully prepaid the same noise into premium—it is a relative pricing map, not a next-week direction manual.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 57.5%，落在高实现波动标签；周末 IV 约 44.0%（Deribit），IV-RV 利差约 -13.5 个百分点，期权相对 RV 偏便宜。ETH 侧 RV 更高、IV 亦高于 BTC，但同样不是「贵到失控」的叙事。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~57.5% ann., tagged high; end IV ~44.0% (Deribit), IV-RV spread ~-13.5 points so options sit cheap versus RV. ETH shows even higher RV and a higher IV than BTC, still not a “rich-to-extreme” story.

vol_combo.zh: 组合上看：趋势向下、波动已实现偏高、期权却相对便宜，同时杠杆更像换手而非单边加码——三者叠在一起，更接近「趋势已发生、拥挤未简单用 OI 表达」的周，而不是低波静默市。
vol_combo.en: Combined: downtrend, elevated realized vol, relatively cheap options, and leverage that looks like churn rather than one-sided add—together a week where trend already happened and crowding is not simply written in OI, not a quiet low-vol tape.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格深跌的同时 IV 并未飙到显著溢价区，反而相对 RV 折价；说明本周波动更多被「走出来」而非被期权市场提前标成恐慌溢价。
vol_price_iv.en: Deep price drop without IV racing into rich premium—instead a discount to RV—suggests more of the week’s vol was walked out in spot/perp path than prepaid as option panic.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 -24.7%，美股波动担忧明显回落，与加密高 RV、强下跌同周出现，强化「传统风险温度计降温、加密自身波动升温」的反差。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~-24.7% over its bracket as equity vol fears cooled, landing in the same week as crypto’s high RV and hard drawdown—sharpening the contrast of cooler TradFi vol thermometers versus hotter crypto realized paths.

vs_crypto.zh: 本周「脱钩：股强币弱」——不能单用股市解释币价。
vs_crypto.en: This week “Decoupled: Crypto Down / Equities Up”—don’t explain crypto with equities alone.

vs_crypto.zh: 本周「脱钩：股强币弱」——不能单用股市解释币价。
vs_crypto.en: This week “Decoupled: Crypto Down / Equities Up”—don’t explain crypto with equities alone.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 传统括号内：ES/NQ 收涨，VIX 大降，DXY 偏强，美十债收益率上行约 29.5 bp，黄金回撤；整体更像股指风险偏好尚可、利率与美元偏紧、避险贵金属未主导，与加密的强趋势下跌形成脱钩。
tradfi_summary.en: TradFi bracket: ES/NQ higher, VIX sharply lower, DXY firmer, US10Y +~29.5 bp, gold weaker—equity risk appetite still workable, rates/dollar tighter, bullion not leading; set against crypto’s strong downtrend as a decouple.

three_conclusions.zh: 本周主矛盾是脱钩：美股与 VIX 降温的同时，BTC/ETH 走出强趋势下跌，传统与加密温度计不再同向。
three_conclusions.en: Core tension is decouple: equities and a cooler VIX while BTC/ETH printed a strong downtrend—TradFi and crypto thermometers stopped moving together.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道持续强流出（BTC ETF 约 -10.65 亿）与现货/永续成交额同步抬升并陈，流出并未对应「无人交易」，而是价跌量热的并行状态。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel stayed strong outflow (BTC ETFs ~-1.07B) alongside hotter spot and perp turnover—outflow did not mean empty books, but price-down with busy parallel activity.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动结构是高 RV、IV 相对折价、杠杆偏换手：下跌已被路径实现，期权与 OI 都未写成极端单边拥挤的简单故事。
three_conclusions.en: Vol structure is high RV, IV at a relative discount, leverage more churn than one-way pile-up: the decline was realized in the path, while options and OI did not write a simple extreme one-sided crowding tale.

text.zh: 股强币弱的脱钩是否在下一窗口收束（加密跟涨/跟跌向 ES/NQ 靠拢），还是继续分道。
text.en: Whether equities-up/crypto-down decouple closes next window (crypto re-links toward ES/NQ) or stays split.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周 tradfi_link 已标脱钩且幅度大，是最需要被下期证伪或确认的宏观对照轴。

text.zh: BTC 现货 ETF 净流是否仍维持强流出，或出现连续净流入日、通道标签翻转。
text.en: Whether BTC spot ETF net stays in strong outflow or prints consecutive inflow days and flips the channel tag.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周强流出且多日净流出，是现货通道最硬的可核对哨，且 L0 已点到该通道。

text.zh: IV 相对 RV 的折价（约 -13.5pt 量级）在 RV 仍高时是否收窄，或 IV 被动跟涨变得不再「偏便宜」。
text.en: Whether the IV-vs-RV discount (about -13.5pt order) narrows while RV stays high, or IV catches up and stops reading cheap.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 高实现波动与期权折价并存在本周很醒目，适合作为下期定价位置的直接对照。

matched.zh: 与 trend_following 匹配：窗口呈现清晰的强趋势下跌与加深的负向路径，趋势类规则更容易与已发生的方向对齐，而不是在震荡里反复被假突破消耗。
matched.en: Matched to trend_following: the window showed a clear strong downtrend and a deepening negative path, so trend rules align more readily with the direction that already printed than with chop that burns false breaks.

mismatched.zh: 与 mean_reversion、vol_harvest 错配：深跌+高 RV 环境里，均值回归容易逆势接刀；IV 相对 RV 折价也削弱「收波动溢价」的舒适区，两者都更吃力。
mismatched.en: Mismatched to mean_reversion and vol_harvest: deep decline plus high RV makes fade-the-move mean reversion prone to catching knives; IV cheap versus RV also shrinks the comfort zone for harvesting vol premium.

why.en: Trend label is “strong_downtrend”; directional backdrop is clearer. Window |return| ~12.7% is material.

note.en: Note: high realized vol or liquidation spike — trend backdrop can still be a rough path.

why.en: Under a strong-trend label, pure mean-reversion conditions are weaker.
